Standard equipment & equipment lines 20 21
>> FOR more
pure
convenience.
Even the standard equipment in the smart fortwo is extraordinary. There are
innovative safety functions like Crosswind Assist, ESP®, ABS, eight airbags,
and cruise control, plus convenient features such as the Direct-Steer system,
Hill-Start Assist, and an instrument cluster with a trip computer. Add to that
intelligent stowage solutions like the passenger seat with a through-loading
function, and you have a vehicle that is as advanced as it is unique.
Interior
> Dashboard and door center panels
in black grained finish
> Fabric upholstery in black
> Steering wheel in 3-spoke design
> Shift lever knob in black grained finish
> Power windows
> Instrument cluster with 3.5” color display
> Automatic climate control
> Radio
> Sunglass box
> Alarm
European model shown. Exact interior not available in the U.S.
Exterior
> Body panels in black or white
> Tridion, grille and mirror caps in black
> Solid roof in black
> 15” steel wheels with hubcaps
> H4 halogen headlights with integrated
LED daytime running lights
